description: Sleek procedural mech wireframe with physical internals fit and power/heat transfer balancing. Every part and sub-component exposes the six attributes: powerDraw, mass, heatGen, heatDiss, rcs, ecm. Design limits are balance and player imagination.

modes.label: MECH WIREFRAME
modes.note: Sleek tapered hulls, swept panels, joint rings and nozzle bells.

modes.label: INTERNALS FIT
modes.note: Transparent shell with physical mounting bays showing where every sub-component sits.

modes.label: POWER / HEAT FLOW
modes.note: Bus and coolant routing with per-node transfer balance and overload flags.

view.note: All geometry is original procedural canvas drawing: no imported models, textures or traced silhouettes. The only design limits are balance — fitting and routing power/heat transfer between parts — and player imagination.
